An optional history_limit requests up to 30 periods of selected metrics, current EPS consensus for at most three future fiscal years where present,

Requires ValuEdge OAuth and uses one unit from the existing account research/valuation allowanc

This tool compares valuation only; use get_stock_fundamentals separately for growth, profitability, or balance-sheet claim

Search ValuEdge's bounded NYSE/NASDAQ research dataset using an available preset or supported filters. A signed-in ValuEdge account is required and account limits appl

tools.name: get_my_portfolio
tools.description: Use this when the authenticated user asks to review their own ValuEdge portfolio, holdings, market value, fair-value coverage, allocation, concentration, or risk context. Never accepts a user id and never returns another user's data.

tools.name: analyze_my_portfolio
tools.description: Use this when the authenticated user asks for their own portfolio concentration, sector or currency allocation, fair-value coverage, or risk context. Explain evidence and limitations without giving buy, sell, or hold instructions.

tools.name: list_my_portfolio_transactions
tools.description: List transaction IDs and exact position records in the signed-in user's portfolios. Only manual records can be edited; brokerage and imported records remain read-only. Use this before selecting a transaction to change or remove.

tools.name: record_my_portfolio_transaction
tools.description: Record a historical or current manual BUY or SELL in the signed-in user's ValuEdge portfolio, without placing an actual trade. Creating a new portfolio through its first transaction consumes a portfolio slot. Enforce current plan limits. Never write to broker-synced portfolios.

tools.name: edit_my_portfolio_transaction
tools.description: Adjust quantity and entry price of one exact manually recorded BUY transaction by its ID. This changes displayed manual holdings and is not a brokerage trade. Check the user's prior record and confirm the intended correction; synced and imported transactions cannot be changed.

tools.name: remove_my_portfolio_transaction
tools.description: Permanently remove one exact owned manually recorded BUY or SELL transaction. Obtain explicit confirmation from the user and use the transaction ID from the ledger. Never remove imported or broker-synced records.

tools.name: remove_my_portfolio_holding
tools.description: Permanently remove all manual transaction records for one holding in one portfolio. Ask for explicit user confirmation and list the affected history first. Mixed-source, legacy, CSV and synced broker holdings are blocked. This does not execute any sale or modify a broker.

tools.name: get_my_watchlist
tools.description: Use this when the authenticated user asks to review their own ValuEdge watchlist, including current price, canonical fair value, margin of safety, quality signals, and data freshness. Never accepts a user id.

tools.name: get_my_smart_alerts
tools.description: Use this when the authenticated user asks to review their own ValuEdge Smart Alerts and the valuation context behind them. Never exposes another user's alerts or changes alert state.

tools.name: list_my_watchlists
tools.description: List the authenticated user's ValuEdge Watchlist folders, including the default folder's ID. This is read-only. Choose an ID before writing to a non-default folder.

tools.name: add_to_my_watchlist
tools.description: Add one verified stock or ETF to my ValuEdge Watchlist. Requires explicit per-client Watchlist write permission granted in ValuEdge. If multiple active listings share a ticker, request exchange. Never modifies a portfolio or broker account.

tools.name: remove_from_my_watchlist
tools.description: Remove a saved ValuEdge Watchlist item, not a holding or broker position. Use an owned row_id when available, or an exact ticker and optional folder ID. Requires explicit Watchlist write permission and client confirmation.

tools.name: create_my_watchlist
tools.description: Create a named ValuEdge Watchlist folder. Requires per-client Watchlist write consent and an active Trial or Unlimited entitlement; this does not change holdings.

tools.name: rename_my_watchlist
tools.description: Rename one owned ValuEdge Watchlist folder, leaving its contents and IDs intact. Requires separate OAuth client Watchlist write consent.

tools.name: get_dividend_calendar
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for a stock's dividend calendar, historical payouts, ex-dividend dates, upcoming known payment dates, or dividend per share. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_stock_technicals, get_my_portfolio, get_my_watchlist, get_my_smart_alerts · Private data: get_stock_valuation, list_my_portfolio_transactions, record_my_portfolio_transaction, edit_my_portfolio_transaction, remove_my_portfolio_transaction, remove_my_portfolio_holding, get_my_dividend_tracker · Public sink: add_to_my_watchlist, get_dividend_calendar · Destructive: screen_stocks, list_my_portfolio_transactions, remove_my_portfolio_transaction, remove_my_portfolio_holding, remove_from_my_watchlist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_stock_technicals, get_my_portfolio, get_my_watchlist, get_my_smart_alerts · Private data: get_stock_valuation, list_my_portfolio_transactions, record_my_portfolio_transaction, edit_my_portfolio_transaction, remove_my_portfolio_transaction, remove_my_portfolio_holding, get_my_dividend_tracker · Public sink: add_to_my_watchlist, get_dividend_calendar · Destructive: screen_stocks, list_my_portfolio_transactions, remove_my_portfolio_transaction, remove_my_portfolio_holding, remove_from_my_watchlist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
